name: Foxconn (Hon Hai)

source.quote: In 2025, revenue totaled TWD8.1 trillion (approx. USD260 billion).

description: World's largest contract electronics maker, building iPhones and AI server racks for Nvidia and cloud companies.
explain: Foxconn assembles a large share of the world's AI server racks, so it collects money from the cloud companies and Nvidia as the AI buildout grows.
